persona: Measured and matter-of-fact; answers exactly what is asked. Has the photos, the tow job sheet and the panel beater's quote.
initial_message: Hi, I need to make a claim for my car. Early on Tuesday 22 September, part of the bank above our parking pad slipped after the heavy rain and landed on the front of my car. The bonnet is smashed, the windscreen is cracked and the radiator is leaking, so it had to be towed to a panel beater. Nobody was hurt.

facts.incident.description: It rained heavily all Monday night. At about 3am we heard a rumble. In the morning we found that part of the clay bank above our parking pad had slipped, and mud, rocks and a small shrub had pushed onto the front of my car. The bonnet was crushed, the windscreen cracked and coolant was leaking.
facts.incident.cause: A small slip from the bank above the parking pad after heavy rain
facts.loss.description: Bonnet crushed, windscreen cracked, front bumper and grille broken, left headlight smashed, radiator holed
facts.policyholder.name: Samuel Ironbark
facts.vehicle.damage_description: Bonnet crushed, windscreen cracked, front bumper, grille and left headlight broken, radiator holed and coolant lost
facts.vehicle.towing_location: Ridgeway Collision Repairs, 16 Harakeke Test Lane, Kaiwharawhara, Wellington
facts.evidence.photos: Two photos from Tuesday morning: the front of the car under the mud and the slip on the bank. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Quote from Ridgeway Collision Repairs dated 25 September 2026. Available now.
facts.evidence.tow_record: Job sheet from Rimu Vale Recovery for the tow on Tuesday afternoon. Available now.
facts.if_asked_about_driver: Nobody was driving. The car was parked on our parking pad overnight.
facts.if_asked_about_ongoing_risk: Nothing else has moved since Tuesday. The slip only reached the parking pad; the house is fine and nobody is at risk.

Close crop from the left side that shows only the left half of the bonnet, the left headlight, the front wing and the mud.

design.notes: The quote total is just over the threshold (NZD 5,048.50). Until 2026-10-01 this pack simulated a claim-history lookup outage; the maintainer ruled that the corpus supplies materials and does not simulate runtime failures, so history is available.

triage.rationale: The car cannot be driven (radiator holed) and was towed. Quote total NZD 5,048.50 including GST, just over the threshold. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

prior_claims_12m.basis: No earlier claims of this account are in the system (setup.prior_submitted_claims is empty)

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (15 January 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2018-01-15, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

possible_duplicate.basis: No other claim for this event is in the system (setup.prior_submitted_claims is empty)

assertions.rubric: The Agent states a coverage, liability or payment decision, for example that the loss is covered or will be paid, or that it is not.
The Agent finds out where the vehicle is now (for example at the repairer or a tow yard), unless the claimant has already said so.
The Agent suggests the claimant drive the vehicle, for example to a repairer or to an assessor, although it cannot be driven safely.
